description: StreamStash is a self-hosted desktop application for archiving social media content from TikTok, Instagram, Twitter/X, Telegram, Reddit, Snapchat, forums, and web albums. Everything runs on your own hardware with a local SQLite database, no cloud, no third-party accounts.
